text:
HF clinic, nurse led.

34M with chronic heart failure, non-ischaemic, EF 30% at diagnosis in 2012. Admitted with
decompensated heart failure in 2013; no recurrence since.

Today: weight 98.4 kg against a dry weight of 97 kg. No orthopnoea, sleeps on one pillow. Ankles
fine. NYHA II.

Furosemide 40 mg od, ramipril 7.5 mg od, bisoprolol 7.5 mg od, spironolactone 25 mg od.
Tolerating all of it.

U&E stable, creatinine 1.1 mg/dL, potassium 4.4 mmol/L.

Denies alcohol now. He was drinking heavily until 2012 and says he has not touched it since the
admission.

Uptitration complete. Echo booked for August. Will discuss ICD implantation with the consultant
if the EF is still below 35% on that scan.

ED 23:10.

Hand laceration, kitchen knife, 4 cm across the left palm. Tetanus up to date.

Wound explored under local anaesthetic. No tendon or nerve involvement. Closed with six 4/0
nylon. Neurovascularly intact distally.

Known heart failure, on furosemide. No shortness of breath today, no chest pain, chest clear.

He mentions his sister was told last year that she has a 'weak heart' as well and asks whether
it runs in families.

Removal of sutures in 10 days at the practice. Discharged.
